rationale: Full article read; 72 table cells individually retained with eight scope and footnote assertions. All19 candidates and non-candidate context accounted. Policy-support X is not absence of functionality, and agent public-code support is annotate-only. No actual enforcement, linked limitation review, adoption, rights or independent omission certificate.

claim_mappings.rationale: DOCS-POLSURFACE-001: The policy-surface article uses the Copilot cloud feature definition; actual target entitlement remains independent.
Category/content type are editorial metadata, not effective-policy evidence.
DOCS-POLSURFACE-002: The article describes IDE, CLI, website-agent and chat surfaces; naming a surface does not certify every policy there.

DOCS-POLSURFACE-003: Each supported feature/surface has a dedicated enable/disable policy, distinct from customization policies. DOCS-POLSURFACE-004: Not every customization/control policy applies to every available surface; scope must be assessed policy by policy.

DOCS-POLSURFACE-005: Table support indicates whether a policy applies, not whether equivalent functionality exists on the surface. DOCS-POLSURFACE-006: Cloud agent can access the Internet even though the Copilot web-search policy does not govern that capability; Disabled web search does not prove network isolation.
